'''Randy Barker''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[April 2001 Greenwood tournament]] on 21 April 2001 with [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|WYS]], according to Eric Bailey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2125">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-22-greenwood-in-4-21-01d2125/ greenwood-in-4-21-01], DeckTech (Eric "YOYOY" Bailey, 22 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-22-greenwood-in-4-21-01d2125/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
